statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead and SSI custodian; SSI duties continue after engagements
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions; none for SSI sharing or unapproved services
Client data only in services the client approved in writing, including AI tools
Subcontractors only with client approval and security terms; never SSI
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.5); 49 CFR 1520.9(a)(2)

statement_summary: Vendor list and annual SOC 2 review of the suite provider
Questionnaire answers backed by evidence
One account per person; no shared credentials
MFA on every account with client data, SSI, or personal information
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.2); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)

statement_summary: Unique 16-character passphrases in a password manager
No anonymous links; named external accounts; minimum extract; remove at task end
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.9(a)(2); C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.5)

statement_summary: Standard daily accounts; admin only for changes
Device lock after 5 minutes (phone 1 minute)
Sealed recovery codes and a second MFA key
Monthly review of sign-ins, external shares, and SSI folder access
Four-level classification including SSI
SSI only in the dedicated folder and encrypted laptop; never on removable media, AI tools, personal email, or with subcontractors
Mark SSI and derived drafts; mark unmarked SSI and tell the sender the same day
Client data only through named shares or client portals
Encrypt every device and removable drive
Paper SSI in the locking cabinet
Refer requests for SSI to Client A and TSA
Return or destroy client data within 30 days of project end; destroy SSI completely; record each step
regulatory_driver: 49 CFR 1520.19(b); C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.7)

statement_summary: Weekly encrypted offline backup without SSI; quarterly restore test
W-9s only in the accounting SaaS; security records kept 5 years
Household devices on the guest network; router password and firmware
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 flow-down (Client A addendum s.9; s.10)

statement_summary: AI tools only after assessment, client approval, and no-training terms; never SSI or personal information; owner signs every finding
Annual security course and SSI awareness module
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Client notice within 24 hours (A) and 72 hours (B)
Inform TSA promptly of released SSI
Florida notices per the P08 matrix
Insurer hotline first; no ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Peer engineer arrangement approved by clients
